decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The LB of Hounslow as the LPA hereby certify that on 31/1/06     
      the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as an 		        artists studio and hobby room  at the rear garden of the house 	 
      measuring a width of 2.5m by 4m long by 3.25m high .would  have been lawful within        the meaning of  Sections 191 and 192 of the Town and  Country  Planning Act 1990,       (as amended), for the following  reason: 
      The proposed development would fall within Class E,   
      Part 1, Schedule 2 of  The Town and Country Planning (General    
      Permitted Development)  Order, 1995. 
      Informative
      The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be   
      used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-
      family dwellinghouse known as 18 the Ride and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not             be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate                dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding
